decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD fits the firm's core catalog, and keeping it in warehouse stock costs little, so the option of continued sales outweighs its carrying cost.
The illustrated release series builds on the label's strength and can be extended with new volumes, so it keeps option value for further investment at low cost.
Limited vinyl reissues can sell out, but listing the remaining stock costs almost nothing and jazz vinyl demand among collectors remains uncertain and potentially rewarding.
Premium box sets are long-tail catalog items whose main investment is already sunk, so keeping them on sale costs little while collector demand persists.
Its weaker website presence suggests limited prospects, but in a 60,000-item stocked catalog its carrying cost is negligible, so dropping it frees few resources.
